name: hearthtale
description: Hearthtale: your WoW character's own journal, written as you play (the addon), and hearthtale.app to read it anywhere

scripts.check: bun run addon:check && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.prepare: husky && ([ -n "$CI" ] || bun scripts/root.ts --run addon-kit/hooks.ts install . >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "prepare: the family's git hooks not installed (bun addon-kit/hooks.ts install hearthtale)" >&2)
scripts.audit: bun scripts/audit-data.ts && bun scripts/names.ts && bun scripts/knowledge.ts && bun scripts/forever-data.ts && bun scripts/client.ts && luajit addon/test/audit.lua > .cache/audit/report.txt && luajit addon/test/playthrough.lua && FOREVER=1 luajit addon/test/playthrough.lua
scripts.addon:seed: luajit addon/test/seed.lua > apps/api/src/db/seed/characters.json && luajit addon/test/sample.lua landing > apps/web/src/lib/samples.json
scripts.addon:ci: bun scripts/locales.ts --check && bun run lint:lua && bun scripts/build.ts --check && bash scripts/parallel.sh "luajit addon/test/sim.lua" "FOREVER=1 luajit addon/test/sim.lua" "FOREVER=1 luajit addon/test/languages.lua" "luajit addon/test/writer.lua" "FOREVER=1 luajit addon/test/writer.lua" "luajit addon/test/french.lua" "FOREVER=1 luajit addon/test/french.lua" "luajit addon/test/german.lua" "FOREVER=1 luajit addon/test/german.lua" "luajit addon/test/spanish.lua" "FOREVER=1 luajit addon/test/spanish.lua" "LOCALE=esMX luajit addon/test/spanish.lua" "FOREVER=1 LOCALE=esMX luajit addon/test/spanish.lua" && luajit addon/test/sample.lua > /dev/null && luajit addon/test/sample.lua landing --check && luajit addon/test/seed.lua > /dev/null && FOREVER=1 luajit addon/test/voices.lua compare > /dev/null && bun scripts/package.ts --check
scripts.addon:check: bun run kit:check && bun run ids && bun run addon:ci
